en.name: Sumida River Walk
en.description: A scenic pedestrian walkway attached to the Tobu railway bridge, connecting Asakusa directly to Tokyo Skytree Town over the river. It offers fantastic waterfront photo opportunities and glass floor viewing panels.
en.reservation: No advance reservation required; tickets available on arrival.
en.parking: Paid public parking options available nearby.

ja.name: すみだリバーウォーク
ja.description: 浅草と東京スカイツリータウンを繋ぐ東武鉄橋沿いの遊歩道です。隅田川の潮風を感じながら歩くことができ、ガラス床窓からの川面の眺めや写真撮影が人気です。
